kyc.label: Passport/identity verification required for voice service
kyc.note: Mobal states Japanese law requires ID for voice-capable products. Delivery requires ID upload and matching delivery address; collection requires the physical valid passport. Voice customers must be 18+.

roamingSms.label: Voice/SMS roaming available on current Voice+Data 5G route
roamingSms.note: Mobal's current Voice+Data 5G product can enable international roaming for a one-off fee. With roaming enabled, calls and SMS can work outside Japan; cellular data roaming is not supported.

wifiCallingAbroad.label: Wi-Fi Calling abroad not verified
wifiCallingAbroad.note: The MVP has not found current official evidence establishing Wi-Fi Calling/Text abroad for this route. Use documented cellular roaming instead when future SMS access matters.

fairPriceCheck.label: Official price baseline
fairPriceCheck.note: This route uses the provider’s own published price as the benchmark. A third-party quote above this baseline may be a markup; this does not prove the official route is the cheapest possible alternative.

data.caveat: A real Japanese mobile number with a higher recurring cost than keep-alive-focused routes.
data.evidence: Current rules; independent outcome coverage limited

data.summary: Mobal accepts online activation requests and offers worldwide delivery or Japan collection. Voice-product ID rules must be completed before the SIM/eSIM access code is released or collected.
data.outsideHomeNote: You can arrange the product before reaching Japan, but collection requires your physical passport and actual mobile service depends on the Japanese network/selected activation date. Recheck shipping timing before relying on pre-arrival setup.

data.inactivity_window: This Voice+Data 5G route is an ongoing monthly service, not an inactivity-based prepaid line. Long-term plan fees renew by calendar month until manually terminated.
data.clock_start_or_reset: For long-term plans, Mobal posts the invoice on the 1st and automatically charges the stored payment method on the 8th. Keeping the monthly service paid maintains the route.
qualifying_activity: Keep billing information valid so automatic payment succeeds.
Port the number before termination if moving to another eligible Japanese provider.
non_qualifying_or_unknown_activity: Incoming SMS or ordinary usage does not replace the monthly plan fee.
For the latest Voice+Data 5G product, the cited suspension page says the Vacation Plan is not available.
The exact non-payment suspension-to-termination grace duration is not stated in the cited official pages.
data.lowest_cost_documented_action: Keep the current 1GB Voice+Data 5G plan active at ¥1,650 per calendar month for this specific route.
data.safest_documented_action: Keep the monthly plan active with valid billing details and verify payment; if leaving Mobal but keeping the number, complete the documented number-porting path before termination.

minimum_expected_cost.note: This is route-specific and does not substitute the cheaper Voice Lite product, which is a different route.

recommended_buffer.basis: Product-side buffer before the automatic payment date on the 8th.

data.grace_or_rescue_window: Unknown. Mobal warns failed billing can lead to suspension or termination but the reviewed official pages do not publish a fixed grace duration for this route.
data.termination_and_recycling: A submitted termination permanently disconnects service and loses the Mobal phone number. Once fully terminated, the plan cannot be reactivated and a replacement SIM/eSIM receives a new number. Exact recycling timing is not published in the cited pages.

reminder.description: Mobal posts the long-term invoice on the 1st and automatically charges the stored payment method on the 8th. This recurring reminder falls on the 5th, three days before the documented charge date.
